CustomField.description:
LEAVE-42. The day count at which a supporting document must be attached before the request can be submitted for approval. Blank means never required; 0 means always, including a half day. Measured against Leave_Days__c, which counts working days, so Friday to Monday is two days and needs no certificate.
Judged per record. A request that LeaveSplitService shortens is measured on the days it is left holding, not on what was originally asked for - see LeaveDocumentPolicy for what that permits.
CustomField.label: Document Required From Days
